description: This file contains the implementation of the CachingIdSpanCodec class, which provides serialization and caching functionalities for IdSpan objects in the Orleans messaging system. It includes cache management, read/write methods, and employs shared and local caches to optimize performance.

classes.name: CachingIdSpanCodec
classes.description: A serializer for IdSpan that caches values and optimizes encoding by avoiding re-encoding and unnecessary allocations, leveraging both private and shared caches to improve performance.

methods.name: ReadRaw
methods.description: Reads an IdSpan from the binary reader, utilizing caching to avoid re-encoding, and performs periodic cleanup of stale cache entries.

methods.name: PurgeStaleEntries
methods.description: Removes cache entries that have not been accessed within a specified time window to prevent unbounded memory growth.

methods.name: WriteRaw
methods.description: Serializes the IdSpan to the writer and updates the shared cache to optimize subsequent serialization of identical IdSpan instances.
